node.title: Re: -E behavior with stdin script (updated x2!)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Note -E doesn't turn on [doc://strict], AFAICT its equivalent is -Mfeature=:all.

Update: Sorry, that's not quite right - :all also enables experimental features and features that were removed from feature bundles of later versions, like array_base. I showed a slightly hackish workaround [id://11136463|here].

Update 2: Here's an improved version that gives exactly the same result as [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/blob/756f0910f/toke.c#L8796|the -E switch]:

use Config; use feature ":$Config{PERL_REVISION}.$Config{PERL_VERSION}";
